name: Suzuki GSX-R400
engine: 398 cc 16-valve inline four, oil then liquid cooling
intro: The 400 cc GSX-R sold in Japan. Many came elsewhere as grey imports.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
A: Many of these are imports. Make sure the title and VIN paperwork match before you put money in.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
